mapper.sql: sys02_user_id AS user_id, sys02_company_id AS company_id, sys02_kor_nm AS kor_nm, sys02_login_id AS login_id, to_decrypts(sys02_passwd) AS dec_passwd, sys02_email AS email, sys02_tel1 AS tel1, sys02_tel2 AS tel2, sys02_note AS note, sys02_admin_yn AS admin_yn
